analysis: The code snippet loops over an array of X509Certificate objects and calls certs[i].getEncoded() inside a logger.tracef call. The javadoc for getEncoded() declares only CertificateEncodingException, thrown when an encoding error occurs. The calling method dumpCertInfo already throws CertificateEncodingException. The code does not perform any null checks on array elements or any validation that would prevent encoding errors. Therefore, the CertificateEncodingException is not avoided by any checks, validations, or other means.
remark: The CertificateEncodingException is thrown if the encoded form of the certificate cannot be obtained, e.g., due to a malformed certificate or internal encoding failure. In this code, the getEncoded() is invoked directly without any preceding validation or handling, so any such encoding error will propagate as an unhandled exception.
